title: Ooedo Renaissance
overview:
These are times of peace throughout the realm.

The era is Tenmei, the place is Edo.

A simulation set in Edo! Keep the Shogun in good spirits, give orders to your officials, and skillfully restore the faltering Edo shogunate!!

Chief Senior Councillor - Tanuma Okitsugu
Genius of the realm - Hiraga Gennai

We humbly accept the task of reforming Edo.

Foreign goods obtained through trade, inventions by the inventor Master Gennai...... With these fragrant items of civilization, the streets of Edo will change in many ways......

天下太平の世でございます

時は天明　ところはお江戸

江戸が舞台のシミュレーション！上様のご機嫌を取り、役人に指令を出し、かたむきかけた江戸幕府を、見事立て直してくだされ!!

筆頭老中・田沼意次
天下の奇才・平賀源内

お江戸の世なおし　うけたまわっておりまする

貿易で手に入る舶来品や、発明家・源内どのの発明品……。江戸の町並が、これら文明の香り高き品々で、さまざまに変化をとげていくのでございます……。
